verdict.rationale: Ramp provides an OpenAPI spec, developer API docs, an official CLI (ramp-public/ramp-cli), and LLM-friendly documentation indexes (llms.txt, llms-api.txt), giving AI-native developers concrete official artifacts to build against. Missing for 10: independent hands-on developer reports validating SDK quality/coverage beyond first-party docs, and explicit mention of language-specific SDKs (vs. just API/CLI).
